title: My Godot lamp is randomly closing on its own.
body:
### Tested versions

The software has been crashing since version 4.x. 

My current version, which has the most crashes, is version v4.5.1.stable.official [f62fdbde1]

### System information

Windows 10 - v4.5.1.stable.official [f62fdbde1] - Compatibility

### Issue description

Godot is crashing and simply closing randomly without any error message or "program not responding" message.

Here is the log I found from `godot.log`:

### Steps to reproduce

There are no specific points that cause the program to crash; it's not a scene with multiple nodes, a scene with 2 or 3 nodes, it crashes on its own at any time. And this happens in any project, not just one in particular.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Unfortunately, I don't know how this happens, and it doesn't happen in just one project, but in all of my projects.

Eventually, this one simply closes.
